subject: session date
fact: The events occur on the 3rd day of the 2nd tenday of Taraskh, 1492.
source_quote: 3rd day of the 2nd tenday of Taraskh, 1492

subject: Gyrgum prison
fact: The prison door creeks open and a voice commands, 'Wake up.'
source_quote: The prison door creeks open, and a voice rings, “Wake up.”

subject: Gyrgum
fact: Gyrgum wonders how much time has passed since his last imprisonment.
source_quote: “How much time has passed?” he wonders.

subject: Gyrgum
fact: Gyrgum does not understand undercommon.
source_quote: The voice speaks in undercommon—a language Gyrgum doesn’t understand.

subject: Ront
fact: Ront is to follow a Drow for daily chores.
source_quote: Ront and Prince Derendil, the deluded Quaggoth, are to follow this Drow.

subject: Prince Derendil

source_quote: Ront and Prince Derendil, the deluded Quaggoth, are to follow this Drow.

subject: Beremil
fact: Beremil is the Drow who takes Ront and Prince Derendil for water-carrying duties.
source_quote: The Drow who took them is Beremil.

fact: Ront and Prince Derendil are assigned to carry water.
source_quote: They will be carrying water.

subject: Shuushar the Awakened
fact: Shuushar the Awakened tells Gyrgum to relax about the chores.
source_quote: the Kuo-Toan Shuushar the Awakened notices and tells him to relax

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir is pointed out by a Drow for cargo-loading duties.
source_quote: The next Drow appears and points to Zalthir, Buppido, Jimjar, and Eldeth.

subject: Buppido
fact: Buppido is assigned to cargo-loading duties.
source_quote: The next Drow appears and points to Zalthir, Buppido, Jimjar, and Eldeth.

subject: Jimjar
fact: Jimjar is assigned to cargo-loading duties.
source_quote: The next Drow appears and points to Zalthir, Buppido, Jimjar, and Eldeth.

subject: Eldeth
fact: Eldeth is assigned to cargo-loading duties.
source_quote: The next Drow appears and points to Zalthir, Buppido, Jimjar, and Eldeth.

subject: Balok
fact: Balok runs the winch and instructs prisoners on cargo duties.
source_quote: Balok runs the winch. They will be helping with loading and unloading of cargo.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz is pointed out by a Drow for chamber pot cleaning duties.
source_quote: Another Drow points at Daz, Sarith, and Stool.

subject: Sarith
fact: Sarith is pointed out by a Drow for chamber pot cleaning duties.
source_quote: Another Drow points at Daz, Sarith, and Stool.

subject: Stool

source_quote: Another Drow points at Daz, Sarith, and Stool.

subject: Guldor
fact: Guldor is assigned the dirty job of cleaning chamber pots.
source_quote: Oh dear, Guldor has the dirty job of cleaning chamber pots.

subject: Gyrgum
fact: Gyrgum is assigned to cooking duties with Shuushar, Topsy, and Turvy.

subject: Imbros
fact: Imbros wants Gyrgum, Shuushar, Topsy, and Turvy to cook.
source_quote: Excellent, Imbros wants us to cook.

subject: Topsy
fact: Topsy is assigned to cooking duties with Gyrgum, Shuushar, and Turvy.
source_quote: Then, at last, it’s Gyrgum’s turn. A Drow appears and points at Shuushar, Topsy, Turvy, and Gyrgum.

subject: Turvy
fact: Turvy is assigned to cooking duties with Gyrgum, Shuushar, and Topsy.
source_quote: Then, at last, it’s Gyrgum’s turn. A Drow appears and points at Shuushar, Topsy, Turvy, and Gyrgum.

subject: Drow outpost
fact: The Drow outpost is located 100 feet in the sky.
source_quote: the Drow outpost was 100’ in the sky.

subject: spider web
fact: A spider web is visible below the prison cell.
source_quote: He looks a little bit more carefully and notices a spider web.

subject: pool of water
fact: A pool of water is located below the spider web.
source_quote: Below the spider’s web, he notices a pool of water.

subject: stalactite
fact: A stalactite is located across from Zalthir’s prison cell.
source_quote: Across from his prison cell is a stalactite.

subject: prison cell door
fact: There is a door across from Zalthir’s cell with two bored Drow guarding it.
source_quote: There is a door, and two very bored Drow are past the door.

subject: Jimjar
fact: Jimjar asks if anyone wants to bet on who dies first if they fall.
source_quote: Wanna bet on who would die first when we splat on the ground?

subject: winch-and-basket device
fact: A winch-and-basket device is attached to the edge of the barracks platform.
source_quote: Attached to the edge of the barracks platform is a winch-and-basket device consisting of a giant swinging arm that carries a thin cord of strong spider silk.

subject: spider silk cord
fact: The winch-and-basket device uses a thin cord of strong spider silk.
source_quote: a thin cord of strong spider silk

subject: hand-cranked horizontal spool
fact: The winch-and-basket device includes a hand-cranked horizontal spool.
source_quote: a hand-cranked horizontal spool

subject: heavy woven basket
fact: The winch-and-basket device suspends a heavy woven basket.
source_quote: a heavy woven basket suspended at the end.

subject: Balok
fact: Balok shouts 'Stop' to the prisoners and instructs them to clean and unload.
source_quote: Balok shouts, “Stop.” He turns to his new slaves and points to the apparatus: “You will clean and unload.

subject: basket being lowered
fact: Balok pulls a stopper and the basket flies over the chasm.
source_quote: Balok pulls a stopper, and the basket flies over the chasm.

subject: quaggoth attendants
fact: Two quaggoth attendants remain by the lift waiting for a signal to lower the basket.
source_quote: Two quaggoth attendants remain by the lift, waiting for a signal from below to lower the basket.

subject: basket dropping
fact: The two quaggoths let the basket drop.
source_quote: The two quahogs let it drop.

subject: Balok
fact: Balok laughs as the basket drops.
source_quote: Balok is laughing.

subject: piece of paper
fact: Zalthir finds a piece of paper with names of people who owe favors.
source_quote: As the basket bounces, Zalthir notices a piece of paper with some names of people who owe a favor to the person who has the paper.

subject: comb
fact: Eldeth finds and pockets a comb.
source_quote: He notices that Elspeth sees him pocket the paper. He notices that she finds a comb. She pockets the comb.

subject: cave
fact: Gyrgum enters a cave as the basket rises.
source_quote: As the basket comes up, he notices Grygum entering a cave.

subject: Gyrgum
fact: Gyrgum thinks not speaking undercommon is awkward but manageable with translators.
source_quote: Not speaking undercommon is awkward, but then again, understanding the language of your captors may be a problem. And anyway, I’ve got plenty of folks around me who can translate.

subject: mess hall
fact: The mess hall is a cave with four circular zurkhwood tables and five chairs each.
source_quote: The cave serves as a gathering and eating place for the drow warriors of the outpost. It has four circular tables carved from zurkhwood, each surrounded by five chairs.

subject: mess hall kitchen area
fact: The mess hall includes a food preparation and storage area with dried fungi, fruits, cheeses, preserved meat, and spices.
source_quote: Part of the hall is used as a food preparation and storage area, containing stocks of dried and fresh fungi, dried fruits, cheeses, preserved meat, and a few clay jars of spices.

subject: iron brazier
fact: A heavy iron brazier provides cooking heat and dim light in the mess hall.
source_quote: A heavy iron brazier provides cooking heat and dim light

subject: Jaezred
fact: Jaezred is a Drow sitting at a table in the mess hall.
source_quote: There are a pair of Drow sitting at a table, looking hungry. Shuushar mutters: “Jaezred and Kalannar”

subject: Kalannar
fact: Kalannar is a Drow sitting at a table in the mess hall.
source_quote: There are a pair of Drow sitting at a table, looking hungry. Shuushar mutters: “Jaezred and Kalannar”

subject: Guldor
fact: Guldor sits at the table with Jaezred and Kalannar.
source_quote: Guldor sits with them.

subject: Topsy
fact: Topsy whispers to Turvy about stealing food.
source_quote: Topsy and Turvy whisper to each other.

subject: Turvy
fact: Turvy whispers to Topsy about stealing food.
source_quote: Topsy and Turvy whisper to each other.

subject: food theft distraction plan
fact: Topsy and Turvy ask Gyrgum to create a distraction so they can steal food.
source_quote: The twins wonder if you could create a distraction by talking to the drow while they steal some food?

subject: Shuushar the Awakened
fact: Shuushar tells Gyrgum he doesn’t speak undercommon.
source_quote: “I don’t speak undercommon.”

subject: cooking distraction suggestion
fact: Shuushar suggests cooking as a better distraction than talking.
source_quote: Can you cook? That would be a better distraction.

subject: Drow soldier
fact: A Drow soldier says something about food being tasty.
source_quote: The drow laughs and says something. Shuushar translates, “Something tasty.”

subject: Shuushar the Awakened
fact: Shuushar translates every insult the Drow uses, omitting offensive words.
source_quote: I have chosen not to repeat offensive words.” And then Shuushar proceeds to translate every insult the drow used.

subject: Gyrgum feigns inferiority
fact: Gyrgum tells the Drow, “Yes, I am the inferior race.”
source_quote: Grygum smiles at the Drow, “Yes, I am the inferior race.”

subject: Gyrgum
fact: Gyrgum realizes he is not a great cook but can put on a great show.
source_quote: he realizes that he’s not a great cook and that many ingredients are unfamiliar, but he can put on a great show.

subject: Gyrgum cooks with flair
fact: Gyrgum tosses ingredients into the air, moves like a dancer, and hums a tune while cooking.
source_quote: As Gyrgum, with theatrical flair, tosses ingredients into the air, moves like a dancer, and hums a tune

subject: knife
fact: Gyrgum tries to steal a knife from the kitchen.
source_quote: As the lunch progresses, Grygum notices a knife and tries to steal it.

subject: Guldor
fact: Guldor notices Gyrgum trying to steal a knife.
source_quote: Guldor notices and Grygum explains that he is just trying to sharpen the knife.

subject: knife confiscated
fact: Guldor takes the knife from Gyrgum and warns him of consequences.
source_quote: Guldor takes the knife and says a bunch of words whose intent is quite clear.

subject: Shuushar the Awakened
fact: Shuushar translates that stealing a knife will result in awful things being done to Gyrgum.
source_quote: Shuushar translates, “They will do awful things to you if you steal a knife.”

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin stands on the bridge south of the prison cell.
source_quote: Thorin is standing on the other side of the bridge south of the prison cell.

subject: waterfall
fact: A slippery path leads to the head of the waterfall.
source_quote: he sees buckets and a slippery path leading to the head of the waterfall.

subject: Thorin considers jumping into waterfall
fact: Thorin considers jumping into the waterfall to land safely in the pool below.
source_quote: he could quite easily land safely into the pool of water below.

subject: Beremil
fact: Beremil shouts to fill buckets and then come.
source_quote: Beremil shouts, “Fill the buckets and then come.”

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir walks by while Thorin fills his bucket.
source_quote: As he fills his bucket, he notices Zalthir walking by.

subject: Beremil
fact: Beremil shouts to take water to Ilvara.
source_quote: Beremil then shouts, “Now, we take water to Ilvara.”

subject: Ilvara
fact: Ilvara was in charge when Thorin and the others first arrived.
source_quote: Thorin recalls how Ilvara was in charge when they first arrived here.

subject: Prince Derendil
fact: Prince Derendil remembers Ilvara greeting him robed in silken garments with two male drow, one scarred.
source_quote: I remember how she greeted me when I arrived. She was robed in silken garments and flanked by two male drow, one of whom had a mass of scars along one side of his face and neck.

subject: Ilvara
fact: Ilvara uses a scourge to remind slaves to obey.
source_quote: Mistress Ilvara liked to impress her will with a scourge in hand and remind her slaves that our lives now belong to her.

subject: Ilvara's pep talk phrase
fact: Ilvara ends her pep talks with, 'Accept your fate, learn to obey, and you may survive.'
source_quote: Every time, she would end her pep talks with the phrase - ‘Accept your fate, learn to obey, and you may survive.’

subject: priestess’s tower
fact: The priestess’s tower is the uppermost level of the largest hanging tower.
source_quote: enter the uppermost level of the largest hanging tower, called the priestess’s tower.

subject: shrine chamber
fact: The shrine chamber has dark silken mats with a pale web-strand pattern.
source_quote: Dark silken mats cover the floor of this circular chamber with a pale web-strand pattern woven through them in silvery thread.

subject: zurkhwood pedestal
fact: A broad pedestal carved from zurkhwood stands in the center of the shrine chamber.
source_quote: In the middle of the chamber (at the center of the web) stands a broad pedestal carved from zurkhwood

subject: spider statue
fact: A 10-foot-high sculpted spider stands atop the zurkhwood pedestal.
source_quote: with a 10-foot-high sculpted spider at its head.

subject: shrine to Lolth
fact: The chamber is a shrine to Lolth, the drow’s spider goddess.
source_quote: This place is a shrine to Lolth, the drow’s spider goddess.

subject: silver candlesticks
fact: Two heavy silver candlesticks worth 25 gp each flank the altar.
source_quote: The altar is flanked by a pair of heavy silver candlesticks worth 25 gp each.

subject: black candles
fact: The silver candlesticks hold thick black candles and are unlit.
source_quote: They hold thick black candles and are unlit.

subject: jet eyes of spider statue
fact: The eight eyes of the spider statue are polished jet: four small ones worth 5 gp each and four larger ones worth 10 gp each.
source_quote: The eight “eyes” of the spider statue are eight pieces of polished jet — four small ones worth five gp each and four larger ones worth ten gp each.

subject: rope ladder
fact: A rope ladder leads down from the shrine into the chamber.
source_quote: A rope ladder leads down from the shrine into this chamber.

subject: Ilvara
fact: Ilvara smiles and holds her scourge as she speaks to prisoners.
source_quote: Ilvara is there. She smiles and has her scourge handy as she flicks it toward her prisoners.

subject: Ilvara's command
fact: Ilvara commands prisoners not to spill water, touch anything, and to fill her bath.
source_quote: “This is my quarters. I am the high priestess of Lolth and commander. Do not spill any water, do not touch anything, and fill my bath.”

subject: Ilvara's chamber
fact: Ilvara’s chamber has black web-like mesh walls, woven floor mats, and a divan-like bed.
source_quote: Inside, the walls are hung with black mesh resembling a spider’s web... Thick, woven mats cover the floor, while a low platform is covered with cushions and pillows to make a broad, divan-like bed.

subject: Ilvara's shrine
fact: Ilvara’s chamber contains a small shrine to Lolth draped in white silk.
source_quote: One side of the chamber contains a small table and two chairs, while the other holds a small shrine to Lolth draped in white silk.

subject: black-stained zurkhwood chest
fact: A heavy chest of black-stained zurkhwood sits at the foot of Ilvara’s bed.
source_quote: A heavy chest of black-stained zurkhwood sits at the foot of the bed.

subject: Ilvara
fact: Thorin notices Ilvara is manic, unlike the typical cold Drow.
source_quote: As Thorin stares at Ilvara some more, he realizes there is something manic about her.

subject: Ilvara threatens Prince Derendil
fact: Ilvara pulls a knife and explains in detail how she will treat Prince Derendil if he disobeys.
source_quote: when Prince Derendil objects to being a chamber enslaved person, Ilvara pulls a knife and points at him and explains in excruciating detail how she will treat him if he doesn’t bring the water.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz collects chamber pots from each tower with Stool and Sarith.
source_quote: Daz and his crew collect the chamber pots from each tower.

subject: Guldor
fact: Guldor informs Daz that they dispose of filth in the lake and clean the buckets.
source_quote: Guldor explains that they collect the filth from each tower in a bucket and then take the bucket to the lake, where they dispose of it and clean the filth.

subject: quaggoth barracks cave
fact: Daz notes a quaggoth barracks cave to the north.
source_quote: Their first stop is at the cave to the north, which they notice is a quaggoth barracks.

subject: quaggoth
fact: One quaggoth is resting inside the barracks cave.
source_quote: Peeking in, Daz notes one of them resting.

subject: high priestess tower
fact: Daz notes that Thorin has a better job at the high priestess tower.
source_quote: The next stop is the tower of the high priestess. There, Daz notes that Thorin has a better job.

subject: Guldor
fact: Guldor warns Daz he will be down before they can run if they try anything.
source_quote: Goldur informs Daz that he will be down before they can run if they try any funny business.

subject: lake
fact: Daz, Stool, and Sarith walk to the edge of the lake and notice it is unusually clean.
source_quote: Daz, Stool, and Sarith walk to the edge of the lake and notice that it is pretty clean, which is odd given the amount of filth being deposited.

subject: Stool
fact: Stool spreads spores in the prison cell, creating a group mind.
source_quote: Stool is happy to be talking to everyone and has spread his spores so that everyone in the prison cell is in a group mind.

subject: group mind coordination
fact: The group mind allows prisoners to coordinate plans without being discovered.
source_quote: This allows them to coordinate any plans without being discovered.

subject: Topsy
fact: Topsy is excited about Gyrgum’s cooking.
source_quote: Topsy and Turvy are very excited about Gyrgum’s cooking.

subject: Turvy
fact: Turvy is excited about Gyrgum’s cooking.
source_quote: Topsy and Turvy are very excited about Gyrgum’s cooking.

subject: Shuushar the Awakened
fact: Shuushar seems excited about Gyrgum’s cooking but cautions him.
source_quote: Even Shuushar seems excited, although he cautions the orc, “If you were to show this cooking to my people, they might imagine a god like you.”

subject: Buppido
fact: Buppido projects his mind and says, “The Divine plan says we must collaborate and share information.”
source_quote: Buppido speaks, or instead projects his mind, “The Divine plan says we must collaborate and share information.”

subject: Buppido
fact: Buppido believes he is a god or is a god.
source_quote: Daz learns from the cleric that Buppido thinks he is some kind of god, or he is a god.

subject: Buppido's escape plan
fact: Buppido says, “The divine plan requires that you create a distraction while I escape.”
source_quote: Buppido says, “The divine plan requires that you create a distraction while I escape.”

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin corrects Buppido, saying, “We escape?”
source_quote: Thorin corrects him, “We escape?”

subject: Buppido accepts group escape
fact: Buppido says, “You have pledged your swords and your spells! And your lives.”
source_quote: You have pledged your swords and your spells! And your lives.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz thinks, “At least we have that.”
source_quote: Daz thinks, “At least we have that.”

subject: Buppido's vague plan
fact: Buppido says, “In due time.” when asked about the plan.
source_quote: Buppido, like any mysterious god or charlatan masquerading as a god, would say, “In due time.”

subject: next day
fact: The next day is the 4th day of the 2nd tenday of Taraskh.
source_quote: 4th day of the 2nd Tenday of Taraskh

subject: Gyrgum
fact: Gyrgum returns to the kitchen on the next day with six Drow soldiers present.
source_quote: The next day, Gyrgum goes to the kitchen again. This time, six Drow soldiers are present.

subject: Shuushar the Awakened
fact: Shuushar explains that the Drow soldiers heard about Gyrgum’s cooking and wanted to experience it.
source_quote: Shuushar explains that they heard about his fantastic show and wanted to experience it themselves.

subject: Gyrgum
fact: Gyrgum wonders how to steal a knife again.
source_quote: The orc is pleased but wonders how to steal a knife.

subject: Topsy
fact: Topsy winks at Gyrgum, indicating they can steal a knife.
source_quote: Topsy and Turvy look at him and wink.

subject: Turvy
fact: Turvy winks at Gyrgum, indicating they can steal a knife.
source_quote: Topsy and Turvy look at him and wink.

subject: knife theft during cooking
fact: Topsy and Turvy steal several knives while Gyrgum performs his cooking show.
source_quote: Topsy and Turvy steal several knives.

subject: Drow soldiers ignore theft
fact: The Drow soldiers ignore Topsy and Turvy stealing knives because they are delighted by the performance.
source_quote: The drow soldiers, delighted at this entertainment, ignore the two deep gnomes who make off with a knife.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir is assigned to the winch again on the next day.
source_quote: The dragonborn monk is once again detailed to the winch.

subject: Zalthir examines winch for escape
fact: Zalthir uses cleaning to examine how to damage the winch for escape.
source_quote: he uses the cleaning to examine how he can damage the winch to aid their escape.

subject: spider silk
fact: Zalthir notices the spider silk holds the basket and winch.
source_quote: The two things that attract his attention are using spider silk to hold the basket and the winch

subject: gears
fact: Zalthir notices the gears the spider silk runs through.
source_quote: and the winch and gears that the spider silk goes through.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz remarks that water-to-ice cantrip could break the gears.
source_quote: Daz had remarked that he could use his cantrip to turn water into ice, and such an effect could break the gears.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir considers fire-breathing as a simpler way to cut the rope.
source_quote: But I breathe fire, and fire breathing is a simpler way to cut a rope…

subject: piece of rope
fact: Zalthir takes a small piece of rope to test its resistance.
source_quote: He takes a small piece of rope to test its resistance later.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin is surprised to see Jorlan bring food.
source_quote: he is surprised to see a member of Ilvara’s polycule bring it. Sethir says, “That’s Jorlan.”

subject: Sethir
fact: Sethir tells Thorin that Jorlan used to be number one but was disfigured by acid and demoted.
source_quote: Sethir says, “That’s Jorlan. He used to be the number one, but after he got hit with acid, his face was disfigured and he lost a finger, Ilvara’s dropped him, and now Shoor is number one.”

subject: Jorlan
fact: Jorlan asks Thorin if he would try to escape if given the chance.
source_quote: Jorlan turns to Thorin, “If I made it possible for you to escape, would you try?”

subject: spore-based group conversation
fact: Thorin connects to friends via spores to ask if Jorlan is an entrapment.
source_quote: Thorin connected to his friends via the spores and asked, “How do we know that he isn’t here to entrap us?”

subject: Prince Derendil
fact: Prince Derendil says there is no abolitionist movement among Lolth worshippers.
source_quote: Prince Derendil explains, “Well we know that there is no abolitionist movement amongst those who worship Lolth. It has to be for his benefit.”

subject: Jorlan's escape plan
fact: Jorlan says he will leave the prison door open and create a distraction so they can grab weapons and flee.
source_quote: I will leave the door to the prison open, create a distraction. The path to the armory will be unguarded. Grab the weapons and flee.

subject: escape route suggestion
fact: Jorlan suggests using the waterfall or spiderwebs to escape.
source_quote: Use the waterfall to slide down, or jump into the spiderwebs and then jump into the pools of water.

subject: Buppido
fact: Buppido says they should go to Gracklstugh, his homeland.
source_quote: Buppido smiles, “To Gracklstugh, my homeland!”

subject: Stool
fact: Stool objects to going to Gracklstugh and says, “No to the great circle! My people!”
source_quote: Stool objects, “No to the great circle! My people!”

subject: Topsy
fact: Topsy says they should go to Blingdenstone because there is a way out of the Underdark.
source_quote: Topsy says, “We should go to Blingdenstone. I know there is a way out of the Underdark from there.”

subject: Shuushar the Awakened
fact: Shuushar objects and says they must go to Darklake first to visit his people and share enlightenment.
source_quote: Shuushar objects, “Yes, but the direct path is through Menzoberranzan. We will have to go to Darklake first, and we must visit my people to share the enlightenment! From there, the path is good.”

subject: Jimjar
fact: Jimjar bets on which path the new guys will choose.
source_quote: Jimjar adds, “Who wants to bet on which path the new guys will want to go? Will they go with the myconid kid? The enlightened kuo-toan? The Destiny Weilding Derro? Or trust the two deep gnomes?”

subject: question about paying debts
fact: Zalthir asks, “We have no money; how do we pay our debts?”
source_quote: Zalthir asks, “We have no money; how do we pay our debts?”

subject: Sarith
fact: Sarith nods in acknowledgment.
source_quote: Sarith nods.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir says, 'You seem to be confident we will escape and live.'
source_quote: Zalthir says, "You seem to be confident we will escape and live."

subject: Gyrgum
fact: Gyrgum asks, 'Where will we find safety?'
source_quote: Gyrgum asks, "Where will we find safety?"

subject: Eldeth
fact: Eldeth laughs, 'Safety? This is the Underdark. There is not enough resources or space for anyone. Survival depends on your wits. People tend to distrust outsiders and view them as a resource to be used.'
source_quote: Eldeth laughs, "Safety? This is the Underdark.  There is not enough resources or space for anyone. Survival depends on your wits. People tend to distrust outsiders and view them as a resource to be used."

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin thinks, 'I know where our stuff is. It’s in the chest in Ilvara’s room. The Drow leader probably keeps all the loot for herself. And if any other Drow had our stuff, they would taunt us.'
source_quote: Thorin thinks for a moment, "I know where our stuff is. It’s in the chest in Ilvara’s room. The Drow leader probably keeps all the loot for herself. And if any other Drow had our stuff, they would taunt us."

subject: Dwarf
fact: The dwarf turns to the Drow and says, 'Your deal is accepted. When?'
source_quote: The dwarf turns to the Drow and says, "Your deal is accepted. When?"

subject: Drow
fact: The Drow responds, 'After a long rest, before you go on your assigned tasks.'
source_quote: "After a long rest, before you go on your assigned tasks."

subject: sleep in slave pen
fact: Everyone’s sleep in the slave pen is troubled and fitful, filled with strange dreams and disturbing images. Dark shadows seem to move and reach out toward them as the characters wander lost through endless mazes of tunnels. Oily tentacles slide to brush up against them while a great buzzing and howling rises in the distance. Suppurating wounds burst open in clouds of spores or crawling masses of maggots or insects. At least one or more of the prisoners wakes in a cold sweat from these nightmares after every rest, feeling as though something is out there in the dark depths — something far worse than the drow.
source_quote: Everyone’s sleep in the slave pen is troubled and fitful, filled with strange dreams and disturbing images. Dark shadows seem to move and reach out toward them as the characters wander lost through endless mazes of tunnels. Oily tentacles slide to brush up against them while a great buzzing and howling rises in the distance. Suppurating wounds burst open in clouds of spores or crawling masses of maggots or insects. At least one or more of the prisoners wakes in a cold sweat from these nightmares after every rest, feeling as though something is out there in the dark depths — something far worse than the drow.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz wakes up and remembers, 'Right, Sethir said there is a grey ooze in the pool. That’s how the waste gets processed.'
source_quote: Daz wakes up and remembers, "Right, Sethir said there is a grey ooze in the pool. That’s how the waste gets processed."

subject: dark shadows
fact: Dark shadows move and reach out toward the prisoners during their troubled sleep.
source_quote: Dark shadows seem to move and reach out toward them as the characters wander lost through endless mazes of tunnels.

subject: oily tentacles
fact: Oily tentacles slide to brush up against the prisoners during their nightmares.
source_quote: Oily tentacles slide to brush up against them while a great buzzing and howling rises in the distance.

subject: suppurating wounds
fact: Suppurating wounds burst open in clouds of spores or crawling masses of maggots or insects during the prisoners' dreams.
source_quote: Suppurating wounds burst open in clouds of spores or crawling masses of maggots or insects.

subject: buzzing and howling
fact: A great buzzing and howling rises in the distance during the prisoners' nightmares.
source_quote: A great buzzing and howling rises in the distance.

subject: Ilvara’s room
fact: Ilvara’s room contains a chest where the prisoners’ belongings are stored.
source_quote: It’s in the chest in Ilvara’s room.

subject: slave pen
fact: The slave pen is where the prisoners sleep and experience troubled dreams.
source_quote: Everyone’s sleep in the slave pen is troubled and fitful...

subject: pool with grey ooze
fact: A pool contains a grey ooze used to process waste.
source_quote: Sethir said there is a grey ooze in the pool. That’s how the waste gets processed.

subject: chest
fact: The chest holds the prisoners’ belongings and is located in Ilvara’s room.
source_quote: It’s in the chest in Ilvara’s room.

subject: Drow
fact: The Drow are an organized group that hoards loot, assigns tasks, and is viewed by prisoners as exploitative and distrustful.
source_quote: The Drow leader probably keeps all the loot for herself. And if any other Drow had our stuff, they would taunt us.

subject: something far worse than the drow
fact: Prisoners feel something far worse than the Drow is present in the dark depths, emerging from their nightmares.
source_quote: something far worse than the drow

subject: after a long rest
fact: The Drow have scheduled an action to occur after a long rest, before assigned tasks.
source_quote: After a long rest, before you go on your assigned tasks.
